Maya R: Quick proposal to standardize retention: keep auth/audit logs 12 months, SIEM exports 90 days, worker/debug raw logs 30 days. Add a JIT 'data-snapshot-access' workflow for older data retrieval. Thoughts?
Omar V: Do we have regulatory bounds that force >12mo for any customers? PCI/ISO requires some things longer. Need legal to confirm.
Legal (bot): Flagging: PCI DSS requires 1 year for some auth events; GDPR objections could require minimization. Send examples to PRIV-legal.
Ethan L: Operationally, 30d for debug is fine. For older ranges we can implement a ticket-driven snapshot that pulls objects from glacier/cold, decrypts via a KMS proxy, and places results into a timeboxed, tenant-scoped S3 share.
Maya R: Important: make the snapshot mechanism tenant-aware and require tenant-owner signoff for partner-managed tenants. Also capture the investigative justification and ticket id.
Omar V: KMS question: if the proxy performs GenerateDataKey, CloudTrail will show the proxy service principal. How do we tie that to the human approver?
Ethan L: We embed requester metadata in the proxy call and write an append-only audit record: {requester, ticket, tenant, range, proxy-call-id}. We then forward a log entry to CloudTrail-compatible logging or to a signed audit bucket.
Maya R: Prefer immutable audit stream with longer retention (2 years) for unwrap events. Make the stream write-once and hash-signed.
Legal (bot): Recommend encryption-of-audit-bucket with separate CMK and restrict access to compliance@redwood. Retention policy should be documented in the evidence matrix.
Omar V: Access control model: add a short-lived IAM role `data-snapshot-reader` granted via an approval workflow. Role duration 24-72 hours, tied to ticket and justification. Approvals require incident commander or data-owner depending on tenant sensitivity.
Ethan L: Implementation note: use an approval microservice that mints STS creds and records TTL. The service calls KMS with a service principal, but includes the ticket-id and user-id in the request metadata and audit log.
Maya R: UI/UX: ticket template must include: incident link, justification, minimal time range, tenant tags, and preferred export format (parquet/csv). Deny if a masked query suffices.
Omar V: Cost/ops: we should queue long retrievals as low-priority jobs and notify requester when data is available; avoid blocking oncall pages.
Ethan L: Edge case: forensic investigators sometimes need incremental chunked access rather than full export. Expose a paged query interface over the snapshot store, still behind the JIT role.
Maya R: Security controls: require MFA + access justification. Alert on any access outside working hours for high-sensitivity tenants.
Legal (bot): Add to compliance checklist: notify impacted tenants when tenant-owned data is accessed by central team. If contract prohibits central access, require tenant-side approval and keep copy in tenant-managed bucket.

Omar V: I'll prototype the approval TTL and tenant gating this week and share diagrams.
Ethan L: I'll sketch the KMS-proxy audit records and sample CloudTrail mapping; include how to cryptographically bind ticket id to exports.
Maya R: Great. @sec-bot please update SEC-2984 with reviewers @Ethan L @Omar V and ping when status hits "design review".
